reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: National AI infrastructure investment
themes.definition: The speaker describes its own national AI investment, such as building an AI hyperscale data centre, and its expected economic benefits.
themes.inclusion: Include descriptions of the speaker country's own AI projects, data centres, or preparation plans for AI transformation.
themes.exclusion: Exclude general statements about AI's global potential without reference to national action.
themes.boundary_cases: A statement that the country 'must prepare' for AI transformation counts here if it concerns national policy, and also AI_OPPORTUNITY_RISK_DUALITY if risks are mentioned.

examples.quote: taking advantage of our strategic geographic location to establish an AI hyperscale data center

themes.label: AI driving energy demand
themes.definition: AI and digitization are framed as accelerating global energy demand, linking AI to energy production and resource strategy.
themes.inclusion: Include passages linking AI to energy consumption, power demand, or energy resources for data centres.
themes.exclusion: Exclude energy-transition passages that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: If AI appears only as an item in a list of transitions next to energy, code AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION instead.

examples.quote: AI and digitization are accelerating this demand at an extraordinary pace.

themes.label: Need for AI regulation and ethics standards
themes.definition: Calls for urgent regulations, ethical standards and governance mechanisms for AI, including welcoming UN AI governance mechanisms.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit calls for AI regulation, governance mechanisms, or welcoming new global AI governance bodies.
themes.exclusion: Exclude calls for responsible national implementation only.
themes.boundary_cases: Welcoming the UNGA decision on two AI mechanisms also qualifies for AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: regulations, ethical standards, and governance mechanisms are urgently needed
we welcome the recent UN General Assembly decision to establish two global AI governance mechanism

themes.label: Benefiting from AI while mitigating risks
themes.definition: AI is framed as offering opportunities that can only be realized with responsible, controlled implementation that mitigates its risks.
themes.inclusion: Include passages explicitly pairing AI benefits with risks or conditions.
themes.exclusion: Exclude purely positive or purely negative AI statements.
themes.boundary_cases: 'Immense benefits' paired with lack of clarity on equity also fits AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE.

examples.quote: only if we can implement AI responsibly and controlled, Suriname will be able to benefit from the opportunities of this technology and mitigate its risks

themes.label: AI transforming health, education, agriculture
themes.definition: AI and other breakthroughs are framed as transforming sectors like health, education, agriculture and public services, advancing sustainable development.
themes.inclusion: Include passages naming sectoral development gains from AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude sector lists without AI mention.
themes.boundary_cases: When AI is one of several technologies transforming sectors, code here rather than AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION if sectoral benefits are specified.

examples.quote: offer the prospect of transforming health, education, agriculture, productivity, and public services on a scale scarcely imaginable a generation ago

themes.label: Technology must not be privilege of few
themes.definition: Concern about equity and access in AI benefits, insisting technology serve all rather than a few.
themes.inclusion: Include statements that AI benefits lack equity or access, or must not be a privilege of a few.
themes.exclusion: Exclude sovereignty/concentration claims about specific companies or states (AI_SOVEREIGNTY_CONCENTRATION).
themes.boundary_cases: 'Privilege of the few' could indicate concentration; code here when the framing is about people's access.

examples.quote: Technology must not become the privilege of the few. It must become the servant of all humanity.
there is no clarity on equity, access, and applicability

value.rationale: Guyana and Suriname link AI to resource-driven development: Guyana ties gas-based energy to an AI data centre and calls for governance, while Suriname frames AI as a coming transformation requiring controlled implementation. 2026_SUR:5 contains no AI content.
